question: Is there any difference between these two rosaries?
premises: these two are in genitive dual
comparison is made to Śiva and Śakti
inference: There is no difference between these two, just as there is none between Śiva and Śakti.
uncertainties: which two rosaries anayor refers to
plain_english: O beloved, there is indeed no difference between these two, just as between Śiva and Śakti.
